name: Iris flower measurements
description: 150 rows of petal/sepal measurements across three iris species - the classic dataset for a first scatter or box plot by category.

name: Anscombe's quartet
description: Four x/y datasets with nearly identical summary statistics but very different shapes - plot them to see why a fit needs a chart, not just the numbers.

name: World population by country
description: Annual population estimates per country and region, from Our World in Data.

name: Life expectancy by country
description: Life expectancy at birth, by country and year, from Our World in Data - a long country/year panel for a time series or a map-style comparison.

name: CO2 emissions per capita
description: Annual CO2 emissions per person, by country and year, from Our World in Data.

name: Titanic passenger manifest
description: 891 passengers - class, age, sex, fare - with who survived: a categorical variable against several continuous ones at once.

name: Diamond prices and cuts
description: 53,940 diamonds - carat, cut, colour, clarity, price - big enough to show what a scatter plot looks like with real density in it.

name: Car fuel efficiency
description: 398 cars from the 1970s-80s: fuel economy against weight, cylinders and horsepower, by country of origin.

name: Exoplanet discoveries
description: 1,035 confirmed exoplanets - orbital period, mass, distance, discovery year and method.

name: Airline passengers, 1949-1960
description: The classic monthly airline-passenger series, 144 rows - trend and seasonality together, good for Smoothing or Calculus.

name: NBA game results since 1938
description: 126,314 games with each team's Elo rating - a large real-world table (about 18 MB) to see the application handle scale.

name: College majors and earnings
description: 173 US college majors with employment and median salary by gender share - from FiveThirtyEight.

name: Marvel comic characters
description: 16,376 characters - alignment, eye and hair colour, sex, first appearance - from FiveThirtyEight's comics dataset.
